invariants.title: The lamp holds, then dies
invariants.rule: The lamp flickers and goes out late in the shot - not in the first frames.
invariants.why: The last beat of the film needs a beat before it; seed 11 killed the lamp at once.

invariants.title: Nobody is in it
invariants.rule: The place alone, as it opened.
invariants.why: The film ends where it began, emptier.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.why: The ending is the light, not the camera.

flair.title: Take
flair.note: 3003 - picked by eye: the lamps hold a beat before they die

title: lights out
beat: The empty warehouse. The nearest lamp sways, flickers twice and dies, leaving the cold blue of the skylights.
